title: Redwood May 2026 All-Hands
summary: Leadership provided product and GTM updates for May 2026: strong Hosted growth, Dedicated pilot expansions, and Private deployments progress. Focus on reliability, cost optimizations (Optimize features), and hiring plan. Roadmap callouts: RU 1.3 runtime improvements, autoscaling policy UI, and expanded observability retention. Company metrics and Ops incident postmortem reviewed. Q&A covered security requests, customer SLAs, and hiring timeline.
topics: Product roadmap: Runtime RU 1.3, autoscaling UI, Optimize
next_steps: Send detailed RU 1.3 release notes to all engineers by 2026-05-21
Shared hiring plan and interview kits sent to managers by 2026-05-24
SE team to publish Dedicated pilot benchmark spreadsheet to internal drive by 2026-05-26
Customer-facing security FAQ to be updated and posted to the docs site by 2026-05-28
action_items: Marissa Chen - publish RU 1.3 performance notes - due 2026-05-21
Liam O'Connor - rollout autoscaling UI beta to Dedicated customers - due 2026-06-10
Diego Martinez - assemble Dedicated pilot benchmark spreadsheet and share - due 2026-05-26
Priya Patel - finalize hiring pipeline and send interview kits - due 2026-05-24
Sofia Reyes - update product one-pager and roadmap links - due 2026-05-22
transcript: 00:00 Jordan Park: okay everyone uh welcome to the May all hands, thanks for making time, we'll keep to about 50 minutes today and then open up for Q&A. 00:11 Jordan Park: quick housekeeping, recording is on, captions will be available afterwards, and please hold questions to the end unless it's urgent. 00:25 Marissa Chen: hi team, I'll kick off with a product update, first congrats to the runtime team; RU 1.2 rollouts hit GA last month and we're already seeing a 12% median latency improvement on hosted for common chat paths. a quick note, that 12 percent is median p50, p95 still has room — we're doing more kernel tuning for long sequences. 00:55 Liam O'Connor: yeah I can add, the RU 1.3 branch has some bigger changes, KV cache pre-warming and a new batching strategy that helps tails, so p95 should drop by another 20 to 30 percent in our internal tests but we need broader canaries. 01:20 Marissa Chen: right, RU 1.3 will also include some memory reclamation logic for multi-model hosts, that helps Dedicated customers with mixed workloads. 01:33 Sofia Reyes: product updates also include autoscaling UI for Dedicated — managers asked for clearer control over burst capacity and cooldown windows, so beta next week. 01:44 Jordan Park: on the commercial side hosted usage is up 28% quarter-over-quarter, nice work on making the API more sticky. remember our thesis — serving wins — so that adoption matters. 01:58 Ava Nguyen: sales update real quick: we've expanded three Dedicated pilots to committed contracts this month, one large fintech that requested VPC + audit logs is moving to a 12 month reserved capacity. 02:18 Jordan Park: great, shoutout to Diego and the SEs on the security review and checklist. 02:27 Priya Patel: hiring update — we closed 9 hires this month and have offers out for 12 more; still focusing on infra, runtime and security engineers. please check the hiring tracker if you're interviewing or have referrals. 02:44 Diego Martinez: quick technical note: the Dedicated pilot benchmarks show our batching improvements save an estimated 18% per-token cost for their typical sequence distribution, caveat that we tuned for their prompt shapes. 03:05 Jordan Park: on Private deployments — we've completed the first on-prem eval with a regulated healthcare customer; still gaps in our installer docs and a few KMS edge cases but overall promising. 03:24 Marissa Chen: yes, the on-prem image now supports HSM integration in our private control plane but the docs need better runbook steps, Diego's team is on that. 03:38 Alexander (Engineering Manager): can you remind the team about the incident last week? I know folks want a short postmortem. 03:46 Liam O'Connor: sure, quick overview: we had a regional control-plane outage tied to an autoscaling race condition in our leader election service which caused ~27 minutes of control plane unavailability for a subset of Dedicated customers. 04:02 Liam O'Connor: root cause was a timing window where two controllers attempted to claim resource leases; fix was to add a backoff and stronger lease verification. full postmortem is on the internal incidents page. 04:18 Marissa Chen: we've also added a mitigation: graceful fallback so that serving continues on last-known configuration, this reduces blast radius for similar failures. 04:28 Jordan Park: thank you to the on-call and SRE teams — they executed well. any follow-ups for prevention? 04:36 Diego Martinez: SEs will provide a compatibility matrix and test checklist for Dedicated customers so we can exercise leader-election windows in staging before prod rollout. 04:48 Jordan Park: good. next, product pricing and Optimize — we're launching new Optimize presets that give recommended batching and quantization profiles by workload archetype; it's an early rollout but initial customers report 15–30% cost reductions. 05:06 Sofia Reyes: those presets are surfaced in the Console now and will be tunable; the plan is to make them suggestions you can accept per-route. 05:17 Ava Nguyen: commercially, Optimize helps us drive expansion motion — we can show concrete unit economics to enterprise customers during renewal. 05:27 Jordan Park: finance highlight, gross margin on hosted improved this quarter by 6 points thanks to caching and slot consolidation. still work to do on tail latency costs but directionally strong. 05:42 Priya Patel: quick people shoutouts — engineering onboarding improvements launched, mentorship program signups doubled, and big thanks to the release team for coordinating RU 1.2. 05:55 Jordan Park: ok let's move to questions. please use the q&a window and upvote, we'll triage. 06:04 Q: (anonymous) what is timeline for RU 1.3? 06:10 Marissa Chen: target is canary late June, GA mid-July pending canary telemetry; document with details will be posted by Friday. 06:20 Q: (anonymous) are we prioritizing more Dedicated capacity in APAC? 06:26 Ava Nguyen: yes, pipeline in APAC is growing, we have a cloud region partner lined up and Dedicated expansion is Q3 focus for APAC. 06:36 Q: (anonymous) any updates on SOC2 / compliance packages for Private? 06:42 Diego Martinez: security update — SOC 2 readiness work is ongoing, audit scope almost complete, and the security FAQ for customers will be updated with encryption and KMS notes by end of month. 06:55 Q: (anonymous) pricing for reserved capacity — any changes? 07:00 Jordan Park: no list price changes this quarter, but we are introducing a more flexible burst policy for Dedicated that will be part of contract terms. 07:10 Q: (anonymous) what about partner integrations with model catalogs? 07:15 Sofia Reyes: yes we are expanding model catalog connectors to make it easier to onboard community models and curated variants; that reduces customer friction for testing. 07:26 Q: (anonymous) will RU 1.3 require re-quantization for some models? 07:31 Marissa Chen: in some cases yes, particularly with newer quantization-friendly kernels; we'll provide conversion tooling and automated checks in the deployment flow. 07:45 Jordan Park: okay a few org notes — leadership will hold skip-levels next week, calendar invites are out; please attend if you can. 07:57 Priya Patel: also new parental leave policy updated, extended to 20 weeks — HR doc link in Slack. 08:08 Jordan Park: financial cadence: earnings and public numbers — reminder we are not public; keep numbers internal, we're focused on growth and margin. 08:22 Liam O'Connor: engineering roadmap highlight: autoscaling UI, RU 1.3, and longer-term model shard routing work for Dedicated customers to reduce cross-model interference. 08:38 Diego Martinez: ops action — SEs to run a Dedicated regression suite by 2026-05-26 to catch the leader election window in their staging environments. 08:50 Sofia Reyes: product will start a small A/B on Optimize presets on May 25th to measure delta on cost and latency for 2 weeks. 09:05 Jordan Park: ok final wrap — great work this quarter, clear priorities: reliability, cost optimization, and scaling Dedicated/Private into regulated customers. 09:18 Jordan Park: we'll follow up with the RU 1.3 notes and hiring plan; thanks everyone. 09:28 Jordan Park: meeting adjourned.
